model: Life insurer BVPS compounding x justified exit P/B at cost of equity, net debt held at zero (engine route)

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 IFRS 17 insurance revenue US$2,911m (CSV Revenue; FY2024 2,724, +6.9%). H1 2026 1,576 vs 1,482 (+6.3%). Insurance revenue is the release of CSM + risk adjustment + expected claims and expenses, i.e. the run-off of the in-force book, not premiums; APE was 2,446 in FY2025 and 1,348 in H1 2026 (+7%).
inputs.share_count_basis: 1,279,622,076 ordinary shares outstanding at 30 June 2026 (H1 2026 interim report, EV and equity per-share notes). H1 2026 adjusted weighted average 1,277.83m. Post-IPO (July 2025, HK$38) and post-consolidation basis. Recurring SBC (~1% of insurance revenue) is charged in the flows, so the count is held FLAT; no buybacks, no convertibles in issue.
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Held at ZERO, the insurer convention in this folder (1336.HK, PRU, GL, LGEN.L). Borrowings US$3,049m at 30 June 2026 are holdco senior and subordinated notes (incl. the Sept-2025 US$575m 5y + US$575m 10y subordinated securities); their finance cost (~US$100m per half, H1 2026) and the remaining US$203m perpetual securities' distributions (US$7m in H1 2026) are DEDUCTED inside the flows, below FWD's operating profit, which excludes them. Deducting the debt again from value would charge it twice. Cash is policyholder/portfolio liquidity inside US$64bn of assets.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Observed FCFE = dividends paid to ordinary shareholders = 0 (FY2024, FY2025, H1 2026: no dividend declared; FY2025 AR dividend policy: 'does not have any present plan to declare or pay any dividends ... in the foreseeable future'). OCF less capex (CSV FY2025 158) is policyholder float, not owner cash, so the identity last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income is deliberately not satisfied. Distributable capacity cross-check: net UFSG US$857m FY2025 / US$381m H1 2026, less financing (US$107m H1) and corporate centre (US$73m H1), ~US$200m per half -- consistent with ~US$400m/yr of underlying shareholder earnings in the base FY2026 year.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report line 18675 'Share-based payments 17 (13)'. H1 2026 statement of changes in equity shows share-based compensation US$34m, of which ~US$18m is IPO-related incentive cost that FWD excludes from operating profit; the recurring ~US$16m/half (~1.0% of insurance revenue) is the sbc_pct_path anchor. CSV StockBasedComp (36 FY2025, 32 H1 2026) includes IPO incentives.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are USD millions; the HKEX quote is HKD. fx_rate converts model to quote: 1 USD = 7.8477 HKD, Yahoo USDHKD=X fetched 2026-10-17 (regularMarketTime 1792181197), inside the 7.75-7.85 Linked Exchange Rate band, so the rate's direction and magnitude are pinned by the peg. Per-share values are computed in USD and converted; canonical intrinsic_value / weighted_iv / entry_price are HKD, comparable to current_price. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z HKEX regular close; 52-week range 26.80-42.14 (IPO price HK$38, July 2025). Price to be refreshed by refresh_price.py.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY 10.5% in USD, because the flows are USD-reported: US 10-year ~4.2% + beta ~1.1 x 5.5% ERP = ~10.3%, plus ~0.25pp for emerging-Asia operating exposure (Thailand, Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam), a controlling shareholder (Pacific Century Group) and a 15-month public record; rounded to 10.5%, in line with LGEN.L 10.5% and above PRU 10.0%. FWD's own EV risk discount rates are a separate, actuarial choice and are not reused. One rate across scenarios; scenario risk is carried in the paths and the bear weight.
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable: lease liabilities ~US$106-114m against US$64bn of assets; IFRS 16 charge sits inside operating expenses already in operating profit.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI equity US$58m; OPAT attributable to NCI was -US$2m in H1 2026. Flows are built from operating profit attributable to shareholders (OPAT 296 + NCI 2 - perpetual 7 = 291 in H1 2026), so no further deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: BVPS compounding x exit P/B at cost of equity -- the dcf-methods SKILL.md routing row for insurers -- run through the component engine with net debt at zero so the dashboard sliders and the generated workbook reproduce it. It fits FWD better than the dividend-FCFE variant used for 1336.HK because FWD pays nothing and plans nothing near-term: value is retained earnings compounding book, then an exit multiple of book. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = IFRS 17 insurance revenue; ebitda_margin_path - sbc_pct_path = underlying SHAREHOLDER pre-tax margin = (operating profit before tax - finance costs on borrowings - perpetual distributions) / insurance revenue (H1 2026: (393 - 100 - 7)/1,576 = 18.1%; FY2025: (654 - 244 - 64)/2,911 = 11.9%, before the Sept-2025 refinancing and the US$750m perpetual redemption cut ~US$72m/yr of servicing); cash_tax_rate = tax on operating profit over that base (H1 2026 97/286 = 34%, high because holdco finance costs get little shield), easing toward 28% as OPBT outgrows the fixed financing bill; da = 0; capex_pct_path = the RETAINED share of after-tax earnings, (margin - sbc) x (1 - tax) x (1 - payout), so the flow is the distribution and retained earnings build book. TERMINAL = BVPS x justified exit P/B: by FY2035 payout is at its mature level (base 70%) with g = ROE x retention (base 10.5% x 30% = ~3.1% vs terminal_growth 3.0%), so Gordon on FCFE equals book x (ROE - g)/(CoE - g); computed exit P/B ~1.01x base, ~1.29x bull, ~0.50x bear. terminal_cap_multiple is set to the target exit-P/B ceiling expressed as FCFE (base 16x ~1.2x book, bull 18x ~1.6x, bear 19x ~0.75x) and does not bind -- the justified multiple is the lower, so no buyer is assumed to pay above what the ROE earns. BOOK ROLL-FORWARD (judgment, not engine output): shareholders' equity US$6,026m at 30 June 2026 (US$4.71/share; fell from 6,614 on -US$1,234m FVOCI debt losses net of +621 insurance finance income and -217 FX), plus retained underlying earnings; OCI assumed nil on average. Book includes US$3.1bn of goodwill/intangibles (bancassurance/acquisitions), which is why ROE on IFRS book is only ~CoE even though tangible ROE is ~14%. CROSS-CHECKS (not the engine): Group EV US$6,949m = US$5.43/share = HK$42.6 (EV net of holdco debt: financing is charged in the ANW roll-forward); EV Equity US$7.88/share = HK$61.8; comprehensive tangible equity (equity + CSM net of tax, ex-goodwill) US$8,825m; CSM US$7,219m. Price HK$31.2 = 0.85x IFRS book, 0.74x EV, 0.58x CTE/share.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: insurance revenue FY2024-FY2025 (+6.9%) and H1 2026 (+6.3%); only two annual IFRS 17 periods exist in Metrics.csv
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity +10.0% FY2024-25 is inflated by ~US$450m IPO proceeds and then fell 9% in H1 2026 on FVOCI debt losses; EV +23% likewise includes IPO capital. EPS moved from a loss to a profit, so no meaningful EPS CAGR. 3- and 5-year CAGRs cannot be computed from the extracted history.
historical_growth.notes: OCF-capex FCF is policyholder float and is not used as a growth series; SBC adjustment is immaterial (~0.6-1.0% of revenue).

base.payout_ratio_path_note: Distribution (payout) ratio path in percent, FY2026-FY2035: 0, 0, 20, 30, 40, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70. capex_pct_path = (ebitda_margin - sbc) x (1 - tax) x (1 - payout), i.e. the retained earnings that compound book value.
base.narrative: FWD keeps compounding: insurance revenue +7.5% in FY2026 (H1 +6.3%) accelerating to ~9% as the 25%-growing new-business CSM flows into CSM release, fading to 4.5% by FY2035. Underlying shareholder pre-tax margin (operating profit before tax less ~US$200m of holdco finance costs and perpetual distributions, after SBC) rises from ~19% (H1 2026 annualised 18.1%) to 24.5% as OPBT grows ~12%/yr against a fixed financing bill. No dividend before FY2028 (prospectus: no present plan), then a ramp to a mature 70% payout. Book compounds to ~US$9.9bn (ROE ~10.5%, i.e. roughly the 10.5% cost of equity), so the justified exit is ~1.0x book.

bull.payout_ratio_path_note: Distribution (payout) ratio path in percent, FY2026-FY2035: 0, 0, 20, 30, 40, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70. capex_pct_path = (ebitda_margin - sbc) x (1 - tax) x (1 - payout), i.e. the retained earnings that compound book value.
bull.narrative: HK HNW/Mainland-visitor and Emerging Markets growth hold double digits for five years; margins expand to 27.5% pre-tax as scale and AI-driven cost efficiency arrive; ROE reaches ~12.4% on IFRS book and the justified exit P/B is ~1.3x, still well below AIA.

bear.payout_ratio_path_note: Distribution (payout) ratio path in percent, FY2026-FY2035: 0, 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60. capex_pct_path = (ebitda_margin - sbc) x (1 - tax) x (1 - payout), i.e. the retained earnings that compound book value.
bear.narrative: Rate cuts and spread compression keep new-business margins falling (Thailand, Japan ESR capital, Pillar Two), insurance revenue grows ~4-5%, margin stalls at 19% pre-tax and ROE settles at ~6.5% -- well below a 10.5% cost of equity -- so book is worth ~0.5x at exit. Payout is also slower to start.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: 25/50/25 rather than the 15/50/35 house default: a 15-month public record, a controlling shareholder, high rate/spread sensitivity (Analysis.json: -50bp = -US$69m CSM, -US$44m PBT) and a group solvency ratio already down from 265% to 203% on Japan's ESR switch argue against tilting to bull; the record H1 2026 (NB CSM +25%, OPAT +20%) and the post-IPO deleveraging argue against tilting to bear.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value FWD as a compounder of IFRS book at a 10.5% USD cost of equity: retained underlying earnings build book for a decade, distributions start only in FY2028, and the exit is book times the P/B its ROE justifies. On these paths FWD earns roughly its cost of equity on IFRS book (which carries US$3.1bn of goodwill), so the base case is worth about book -- near the market price -- and the upside case requires ROE well into double digits. The embedded-value view (EV HK$42.6/share, EV Equity HK$61.8) is higher because it capitalises VIF and goodwill at FWD's own risk discount rates; that gap is the bull case the market is not paying for yet.
key_risks_to_valuation: Interest rates and credit spreads: FVOCI debt losses cut book 9% in H1 2026 alone; a 50bp rate fall cuts CSM by ~US$69m
New-business margin compression in Thailand, Japan and Emerging Markets (NBM -5.1pp in FY2025) slowing CSM growth
Holdco financing (~US$200m/yr) is the swing between operating profit and shareholder earnings; a refinancing at higher coupons or a missed leverage target hurts ROE directly
Capital: Japan ESR moved group LCSM 265% -> 203%; ICS/IAIG standards could delay the payout ramp the model assumes from FY2028
Controlling shareholder (Pacific Century Group) governance, related-party and overhang risk
Exit P/B is justified from ROE; if the market keeps a pan-Asian challenger at 0.6x P/(ANW+CSM) the exit is lower than modelled

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKD); 52-week range 26.80-42.14. FX bridge: USD financials to HKD quote at inputs.fx_rate (USDHKD=X, 2026-10-17), see inputs.fx_note. Price refresh is a separate step (refresh_price.py), which does not move fx_rate.
data_sources.financials: 1828.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2024-H1 FY2026, USD millions); FY2025 Annual Report and H1 2026 Interim Report (operating profit reconciliation note 4.2, movement in total equity, EV disclosure, free surplus table).
